name: Mazda Ltd
about: Mazda Limited, incorporated in 1990, is engaged in the business of manufacturing Engineering goods like Vacuum Products, Evaporators, Pollution Control Equipments and Manufacturing of Food Products like Food colour, Various Fruit Jams & Fruit mix Powders etc. [1]

flags.text: Debtor days rose from 70 to 102 in three years: customers are taking longer to pay
Cash conversion cycle stretched from 205 to 407 days in three years
Only 50% of the last five years' profit arrived as operating cash

business.what: Mazda Limited manufactures engineering equipment including vacuum systems, evaporators, and air pollution control systems. It also operates a food division, primarily exporting products to global markets.

segments.name: Vacuum Systems
segments.comment: Performance impacted by client project delays and boiler maintenance downtime.

segments.name: Evaporator Division
segments.comment: Experiencing growth but generally offers lower profitability compared to vacuum systems.

segments.name: Air Pollution Control
segments.comment: Expected order size is around 6 crores with significant potential for market share increase.

segments.name: Foods Division
segments.comment: Export performance fluctuates due to macroeconomic conditions in various international markets.

ledger.promise: Top line growth of around 15% with bottom line in line for FY24
ledger.quote: So the top line is expected to see a growth of around 15% compared to last year when the bottom line will also be more or less in line with that.
ledger.actual: FY24 revenue was Rs 225 crore and PAT was Rs 32 crore; reported numbers do not include FY23 base revenue or PAT to compute growth.

ledger.promise: New products to boost turnover by around 10% in the next year (FY25)
ledger.quote: this has just picked up actually, maybe it could give a boost of around 10% in the turnover to us in the next year
ledger.actual: FY25 revenue contracted by 14.2% to Rs 193 crore from Rs 225 crore in FY24.

ledger.promise: Achieve total turnover of Rs 500 crore in 5 years
ledger.quote: our ultimate aim is to grow and make it a 500 crore companies.
ledger.actual: TTM revenue reached Rs 275 crore by Q2 FY27; the five-year window runs until FY28.

ledger.promise: Achieve annual turnover of Rs 60 crore within three years at full capacity for food unit
ledger.quote: With everything in place, we aim to achieve annual turnover of ₹ 60 Crore within three years, which would be the full capacity.
ledger.actual: Target deadline is FY28; standalone financial filings do not break out separate unit turnover.

ledger.promise: Increase turnover by 10% to 15% with new products in coming years
ledger.quote: But we have kept a modest target of increasing our turnover by 10 or 15% with these new products in the coming years.
ledger.actual: FY26 revenue grew 9.8% to Rs 212 crore, and quarterly revenue surged to Rs 80 crore in Q1 FY27 and Rs 83 crore in Q2 FY27.

ledger.promise: Food segment to grow 15% next year and onward
ledger.quote: On the food side, since the factory has been operational this year, we are anticipating a 15% growth next year and onward.
ledger.actual: Segment-wise food revenue is not separately disclosed in reported standalone quarterly or annual figures.

ledger.promise: Moderate inquiries growth of 10% to 20% for coming 2 to 3 years
ledger.quote: we expect moderate inquiries of growing generally by 10 or 15% at the most, 20% for the coming 2 to 3 years
ledger.actual: Order inquiry data and sales lead pipelines are not reported in published financial statements.

ledger.promise: Launch Chemical-Free CIP Solution in latter half of 2026
ledger.quote: We expect to launch this in the latter half of 2026.
ledger.actual: Target period is H2 2026; product launch confirmation has not been reported.

ledger.quote: We expect to launch it in 2027.
ledger.actual: Target launch period of 2027 has not yet arrived.

credibility.label: mixed
credibility.summary: Management missed near-term FY25 growth expectations as revenue fell 14.2% while working capital deteriorated severely, pushing cash conversion cycle to 407 days in FY26. However, top-line execution recovered in FY26 and accelerated strongly into Q1-Q2 FY27 while keeping zero debt.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management cited client failure to lift ready products due to cash constraints and project delays for slow performance in early FY25.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: FY25 revenue fell 14.2% to Rs 193 crore, inventory days expanded from 113 to 178 days, and debtor days rose from 54 to 77 days.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management targets steady annual turnover growth of 10-15% backed by operational efficiency.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Cash conversion cycle expanded sharply from 122 days in FY24 to 407 days in FY26 (inventory days reached 394), driving CFO into negative territory at -Rs 19 crore in FY26.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Q1 profitability is suppressed due to depreciation burdens reflecting over the next couple of years.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Q1 EBITDA margins dropped to 6.0% in Q1 FY26 and 8.8% in Q1 FY27, substantially below non-Q1 periods such as Q3 FY26 (23.4%) and Q2 FY27 (27.7%).

bull.point: Top-line and profitability expanded sharply in FY27.
bull.evidence: Quarterly revenue surged to Rs 80 crore in Q1 FY27 and Rs 83 crore in Q2 FY27, with Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin rising to 27.7% and PAT reaching Rs 16 crore.

bull.point: Company maintains a completely debt-free capital structure.
bull.evidence: Borrowings remained at Rs 0 crore across FY24, FY25, FY26, and FY27.

bull.point: New equipment product launches scheduled for 2026-2027.
bull.evidence: Management confirmed launches for Chemical-Free CIP Solution in H2 2026 and High Gravity-Based Equipment in 2027.

bear.point: Severe working capital lockup with extreme inventory days.
bear.evidence: Cash conversion cycle lengthened from 122 days in FY24 to 407 days in FY26, as inventory days spiked from 113 to 394 days and debtor days expanded to 102 days.

bear.point: Cash flow from operations turned negative in FY26.
bear.evidence: Cash from operations dropped from Rs 43 crore in FY24 to Rs 11 crore in FY25, and plunged to -Rs 19 crore in FY26.

bear.point: Vulnerability to customer off-take delays and project execution freezes.
bear.evidence: Failure of clients to lift finished goods led to a 14.2% top-line decline in FY25 (Rs 193 crore vs Rs 225 crore in FY24) and lost production days due to boiler maintenance.
